comment: Three parameters have no widget on the panel and so carry no line and no tag: Channel, Output and Input, which are the focus selectors the band letters and channel numbers drive. The RAND, WIG and INIT buttons are added as plain child widgets rather than parameters, so they cannot be clicked for help either; a note covers them. The panel lettering could not be rendered from the plugin's own SVG, which draws the module at runtime; the library screenshot at https://library.vcvrack.com/screenshots/400/computerscare/computerscare-volypector.png was used for it. Read at commit e427761, where plugin.json carries the installed 2.3.11; the only later change to this module on master, commit 8d276c7, alters tooltips alone.
